info.name: KitchenSink Member Management API
info.description: API collection for Auth0 bearer-token testing. Set baseUrl, accessToken, and IDs in collection variables. Member create requires an Idempotency-Key. User and role administration requires the matching manage permission.

request.description: Copy page.nextCursor from the previous response into memberCursor.

item.name: Create member
item.description: Requires member:create and an Idempotency-Key header. Response includes the generated member ObjectId and memberId.

item.name: Update member
item.description: Requires member:update. Set version to the current record version; successful updates increment it.

item.name: Create role
item.description: Requires role:manage. Supported permissions: member:view, member:create, member:update, member:delete, user:manage, role:manage. Member write permissions require member:view.

item.name: Delete role
item.description: Requires role:manage. System roles and roles assigned to users cannot be deleted.

item.name: List users
item.description: Requires user:manage. Auth0 identity emails and roles are returned; credentials are never stored by the application.

item.name: Set user active status
item.description: Requires user:manage. You cannot deactivate yourself or the last active admin.

item.name: Register Auth0 identity
item.description: Requires user:manage. Register an email identity that already exists in the Auth0 tenant and assign local roles.

item.name: Assign Auth0 identity roles
item.description: Requires user:manage. Self-role changes and removal of the last active admin are blocked.

item.name: Register Auth0 identity
item.description: Requires user:manage. Register an email identity that already exists in Auth0.

item.name: Assign Auth0 identity roles
item.description: Requires user:manage. Self-role changes and last-admin removal are blocked.
